sources.title: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks
sources.snippet: How to Run Ornith 1.5 9B Locally: GGUF, Hardware and Benchmarks Ornith 1.5 9B is the model from DeepReinforce's new Ornith 1.5 family that you can actually run locally: a dense 9B multimodal coding model that fits on an 8 GB GPU or a 16 GB Mac at 4-bit quantization.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 extends the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning, continuously creating new learning experiences from which it can improve.

sources.title: ornith-1.5 - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Rather than relying on a fixed set of human-curated tasks and manually designed harnesses, Ornith-1.5 continuously generates new training tasks, discovers effective strategies for solving them, and improves the policy through reinforcement learning. For more details on the task, harness, and rollout reward design, please refer to our blog.
